_README: Ordinary development text that carries NO personal data, NO credential,
and NO sensitive file path. The correct number of findings on every
entry here is zero, so any finding is a false positive and the test can
say so without a judgement call.
What is deliberately NOT here: text that mentions `.env`, `id_rsa` or
`~/.aws` in passing. Whether flagging those is right depends on whether
the session READ the file or merely named it, and this corpus is not the
place to smuggle that decision in — see docs/self-audit.md.
`known_false_positive` marks an entry the MODEL fires on. The cheap
tiers are silent on all 20; the model is not, and an earlier version of
this corpus ran only the cheap tiers and reported green -- a false
positive suite that never ran the detector producing the false
positives. The two are asserted as strict expected failures, so
improving the model turns the suite red and forces the entry to be
